python_interfaces.name: ImportSettingsReader
python_interfaces.rule: reader returns configured value only; it never substitutes Downloads for an unset setting

python_interfaces.name: ImportRunRepository
python_interfaces.rule: cleanup is valid only while run is validating; published source evidence is immutable

python_interfaces.name: ProposalRepository
python_interfaces.rule: proposal changes/dispositions are append-only and owner never performs domain mutation directly

python_interfaces.name: CustomerCandidateMatcher
python_interfaces.rule: name alone is descriptive evidence; ambiguity never guesses

python_interfaces.name: RfcImportReader
python_interfaces.rule: authoritative acceptance re-reads through the current UnitOfWork

python_interfaces.name: RfcImportMutationService
python_interfaces.contract: one outer LLD-04 command envelope supplies command_context/command_id and owns exactly-once receipt orchestration; LLD-03 methods participate in the supplied UoW, add their required domain/audit/result rows, and never commit or insert a second receipt independently. Terminal projection keeps LLD-03 terminal-epoch/pending-cascade semantics.

python_interfaces.name: WfmImportReader
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-04 reads source/task planning context but never owns Task lifecycle or Objective membership

python_interfaces.name: WfmImportMutationService
python_interfaces.contract: same outer command receipt/UoW pattern as RfcImportMutationService; source-plan acceptance remains separate from operational Task-plan and Objective-regrouping acceptance unless LLD-05 explicitly exposes a separately reviewed action

python_interfaces.name: ExistingServiceRequestMatcher
python_interfaces.rule: candidate extraction can match existing SR only and never creates one

python_interfaces.name: ImportAuditPayloadFactory
python_interfaces.rule: payloads are named/versioned/minimal and never serialize workbook rows or exceptions wholesale

uow_rule: Any proposal acceptance that mutates domain state uses exactly one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork and one command receipt. Cross-domain services receive the same UoW and command context; they may add required owner audit/result evidence but cannot commit or create competing receipts.
future_compatibility: LLD-05 must satisfy the WFM interfaces before full Beta LLD acceptance. Until then LLD-04 construction pins the required contract without inventing Task schema.
